task.text: `Route` is shared between threads, but callers can change it in three ways.
Make `Route` an **immutable object**. Keep the constructor, the accessors, `withName`, `withStop` and `sample()` as they are; only their behaviour changes.

items: The constructor must not keep the caller's list or `Date`.
`stops()` and `departure()` must not let a caller change the route (a copy or an unmodifiable view).
`withName` and `withStop` return a new `Route` and leave the original untouched.
Every field is `final`, and `Route` has no setter.

checks.title: Changing the source list does not leak in
Changing the source Date does not leak in
stops() cannot be used to change the route
departure() cannot be used to change the route
Eight threads derive from one base safely
Route and all its fields are final

hints.text: An object is immutable only if nobody holds a reference that can change it. Look for every place a mutable object crosses the boundary: going in, coming out, and the methods that edit `this`.
Copy defensively on the way in (constructor) and on the way out (`Date`). Make `name` final. A wither builds a modified copy and calls the constructor; it never writes a field.
